content: आहृ €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To bring, fetch; यदेव वव्रे तदपश्यदाहृतम् <ls>R. 3. 6</ls>; पुष्पं फलं चार्तवमाहरन्त्यः <ls n="R.">14. 77</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 8</ls>; प्रतिवाक्यम् to bring an answer; वार्ताम् bring news. .²2 To bring near, give; चन्द्रगुप्ताय मेदिनीम् <ls>Kām. 1. 5</ls>; अयाचिताहृत <ls>Y. 1. 215</ls>. .²3 To recover, bring back. .²4 To obtain, get, receive; व्रह्मचार्याहरेद्भैक्षम् <ls>Ms. 2. 183</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 27</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 80</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 151</ls>. (<ab>v. l.</ab>) <ls n="Ms.">11. 12</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 97</ls>. .²5 To have, assume; आजह्रतुस्तच्चरणौ … श्रियम् <ls>Ku. 3. 33</ls>. .²6 To cause, produce, lead to; बलोपचयम् <ls>K. 105</ls>; प्रीतिम्, क्रोधम् <ab>&c.</ab>; जनकानां कुले कीर्तिमाहरिष्यति मे सुता <ls>Rām.</ls> .²7 To bring near (as wife), marry; अत आहर्तुमिच्छामि पार्वतीमात्मजन्मने <ls>Ku. 6. 28</ls>. .²8 To wear, put on (as armour <ab>&c.</ab>); स वल्कवासांसि तवाधुनाहरन् <ls>Ki. 1. 35</ls>. .²9 To offer in a sacrifice; to perform (as a sacrifice); स विश्वजितमाजह्रे <ls>R. 4. 86</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 87</ls>. .²10 To take away, attract (as mind). .²11 To separate, remove, draw off from. .²12 To scare or frighten away, drive forth. .²13 To use as food or drink, eat. .²14 To speak, say, name, call. . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To make one fetch or bring, cause to give or pay; शस्त्रेण वैश्यान् रक्षित्वा धर्म्यमाहारयेद् बलिम् <ls>Ms. 10. 119</ls>. .²2 To eat. .²3 To bring together, collect; <ls>Pt. 3. 151</ls>. .²4 To cause, produce. .²5 To exact. .²6 To show, exhibit.
